title: Config
description: windlock.yml, schema 1: the Zephyr revisions to install and the build targets. windlock writes this file; see lockfile/SCHEMA.md.

schema.description: The config format version. A file without it is schema 1.

zephyr.description: Upstream revisions, the first being the default; empty in a west.yml project, whose manifest names the revision.

target.description: The target build uses when the command names none.

targets.description: The build targets by name. A name is one path segment, since it names build/<name>.

sysbuild.description: Builds the target with west build --sysbuild, which also builds and signs companion images such as MCUboot.
